evidence.quote: the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 1/4 to 1/2 percent
The Committee expects that economic conditions will evolve in a manner that will warrant only gradual increases in the federal funds rate
In light of the current shortfall of inflation from 2 percent, the Committee will carefully monitor actual and expected progress toward its inflation goal.
labor market conditions have improved further even as growth in economic activity appears to have slowed
it anticipates doing so until normalization of the level of the federal funds rate is well under way
Voting against the action was Esther L. George, who preferred at this meeting to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/2 to 3/4 percent.

parsed.rationale: The Committee held rates and repeated its guidance of only gradual increases, citing below-target inflation and slowing growth, but also noted strengthening labor markets, dropped explicit global risk language and saw a hawkish dissent. Net signal is roughly neutral with a slight dovish tilt.
